# Purpose

Award credit for a consistent torque sign convention, correct cumulative internal torques, a labeled torque diagram, proper circular-shaft stress equations, upward wall-thickness selection, verification, and a bounded engineering recommendation.

# Scope of the Base Problem

The base model assumes circular prismatic shaft segments, concentrated static torques, ideal bearings that do not resist shaft-axis torque, linear elasticity, and Saint-Venant torsion. A complete design also requires gear-force bending, combined stress, fatigue, keyways and shoulders, stress concentrations, angular twist, critical speed, bearing selection, tolerances, and applicable standards.

# Supplemental Assessment Structure

- context interpretation and idealization: 20%;
- torque equilibrium and internal torque diagram: 30%;
- solid-shaft stress and governing segment: 20%;
- tubular-shaft sizing and verification: 20%;
- engineering recommendation and limitations: 10%.
